item.title: Natchitoches Catholic Daughters name Co-Catholic Daughters of the Year
item.description: Dottie Mims, at left, and Gwen Ponthieux, center, were recently recognized by the Natchitoches Catholic Daughters as co-Catholic Daughters of the Year. It was the first time in the history of the local organization that two members each received equal votes for this award. item.title: Cold weather to bring wind, rain, freezing temperatures to Natchitoches Parish this week
item.description: A strong cold front is moving into North Central Louisiana this week, bringing windy conditions, falling temperatures and the potential for freezing overnight lows, according to the latest forecast for Natchitoches Parish. Monday will be partly cloudy and much cooler, with highs in the lower 50s.
